mapper.select:
select T.SEQNO from BOK_BOOKDETAIL_ALL T where 1=1 AND T.HAPPEN_DATE >= #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND #{BOOK_DATE} >= T.HAPPEN_DATE AND #{BOOK_DATE} >= T.BOOK_DATE
AND exists ( select 'X' from BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO P where 1=1 AND P.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND P.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND P.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'Y' FROM BOK_MATCH_RLAT B WHERE B.MATCH_TYPE = #{matchType} AND B.SOURCE=P.TASK_ID )
and T.BOOKSET_ID = P.BOOKSET_ID and P.TASK_ID = T.TABLE_ID and T.BOK_DETAIL_ID = IFNULL(P.BOK_DETAIL_ID, T.BOK_DETAIL_ID) )
